# Cycle112 second-screen readiness fixtures

Reduced official Voyemu verify reports from the retained failed second installer boot and its later finalizer snapshot. Report fields and all220 check identities/expected values remain intact; large actual object dumps are removed and long strings truncated to500 characters. These are host regression inputs, not emulator acceptance receipts. `prepared.json` retains only the machine fields consumed by prepared() and the passing reduced checks.
